";

function draw(eye,yaw,lens,fog,buffer=vertexBuffer,count=data.length/10) {

  gl.uniform1f(yawUniform,yaw);gl.uniform1f(fogUniform,fog);

    fog&&game.started?(walking?-.25+game.pedestrian.pitch:game.exterior?-.22:game.pitch):0);

  gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,count);

const traffic=Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>({
  z:[25,39,101][i%3]+Math.floor(i/3)*118,
  lane:[.9,-4.2,4.4][i%3],
  car:cars[[2,1,0][i%3]],
  v:17+i%5*2

const drifter={z:0,lane:0,car:cars[3],v:10,seen:false,active:false};
traffic.push(drifter);
const driftSmoke=[];
const blasts=[];
let blastFlashUntil=0;
function blastCar(car){
  const z=car.z,x=roadCenter(z)+trafficLane(car),y=roadHeight(z)+.6;
  const sparks=Array.from({length:14},(_,i)=>{
    const angle=i*2.4;
    return {dx:Math.cos(angle)*(3+i%4),dz:Math.sin(angle)*(3+i%5),lift:2.8+i%5};
  });
  blasts.push({x,y,z,time:game.elapsed,sparks});

let nextSmoke=0;
function driftPhase(time=game.elapsed){return time*1.22;}
function trafficLane(car,time=game.elapsed){
  return car.lane+(car===drifter?3.65*Math.sin(driftPhase(time)):0);
}
function driftAngle(){
  const t=driftPhase();
  return .36*Math.cos(t-.85)+.09*Math.sin(t*2);
}
function emitDriftSmoke(){
  if(game.elapsed<nextSmoke)return;
  nextSmoke=game.elapsed+.075;
  const slip=driftAngle();
  if(!drifter.active||Math.abs(slip)<.12||Math.abs(drifter.z-game.km*WORLD)>230)return;
  const z=drifter.z, heading=roadYawAt(z)+slip, x=roadCenter(z)+trafficLane(drifter);
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const rear=-1.44, lateral=side*.74;
    driftSmoke.push({x:x+lateral*Math.cos(heading)+rear*Math.sin(heading),
      z:z+rear*Math.cos(heading)-lateral*Math.sin(heading),y:roadHeight(z)+.24,
      time:game.elapsed,dx:Math.sin(heading)*1.9+side*.27,dz:Math.cos(heading)*3,
      opacity:.28+.19*Math.abs(slip)/.45,phase:game.elapsed*7+side});
  }
}
function drawSigns(eye,yaw,lens) {
  signCtx.clearRect(0,0,signs.width,signs.height);
  const cs=Math.cos(yaw),sn=Math.sin(yaw);
  const lamps=[];
  if(game.started) for(let p=Math.ceil((eye[2]+8)/36)*36;p<eye[2]+430;p+=36)
    lamps.push({x:roadCenter(p)-6.16,y:roadHeight(p)+7.37,z:p,light:true});
  const smoke=driftSmoke.map(p=>{
    const age=game.elapsed-p.time;
    return {x:p.x+p.dx*age+Math.sin(p.phase+age*2)*age*.28,z:p.z+p.dz*age,
      y:p.y+age*.48,smoke:true,age,opacity:p.opacity};
  });
  const fire=[];
  for(const blast of blasts){
    const age=game.elapsed-blast.time;
    fire.push({x:blast.x,y:blast.y+age*1.3,z:blast.z,blast:true,age});
    if(age>.12)for(const side of [-1,0,1])smoke.push({
      x:blast.x+side*age*1.5,y:blast.y+age*(1.5+Math.abs(side)*.45),z:blast.z+side*age,
      smoke:true,age:age+.3,opacity:.46
    });
    if(age<.93)for(const spark of blast.sparks)fire.push({
      x:blast.x+spark.dx*age,y:blast.y+spark.lift*age-4.5*age*age,z:blast.z+spark.dz*age,blast:true,age,spark:true
    });
  }
  for(const label of [...lamps,...smoke,...fire,...labels]){
    const dx=label.x-eye[0],dz=label.z-eye[2], z=dx*sn+dz*cs;
    if(z<2||z>(label.light?440:175)) continue;
    const clipX=(dx*cs-dz*sn)*lens[0]/z;
    const clipY=(label.y-eye[1])*lens[1]/z+.39+(game.started?(game.pedestrian?-.25+game.pedestrian.pitch:game.exterior?-.22:game.pitch):0);
    const roll=game.started&&!game.pedestrian?(game.exterior?game.roll*.22:game.roll):0;
    const x=(.5+(clipX*Math.cos(roll)-clipY*Math.sin(roll))*.5)*signs.width;
    const y=(.5-(clipX*Math.sin(roll)+clipY*Math.cos(roll))*.5)*signs.height;
    if(game.started&&!game.exterior&&!game.pedestrian&&trimReady&&y>signs.height*.385)continue;
    if(label.blast){
      const life=label.spark?.93:1.65;
      const opacity=Math.max(0,1-label.age/life);
      const meters=label.spark?.11:(.7+Math.min(label.age,.65)*4.1);
      const r=clamp(meters*lens[1]*signs.height/(2*z),1,108);
      const halo=signCtx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);
      halo.addColorStop(0,label.age<.21?`rgba(255,246,195,${opacity})`:`rgba(255,148,49,${opacity})`);
      halo.addColorStop(.38,`rgba(255,88,22,${opacity*.9})`);
      halo.addColorStop(.75,`rgba(155,54,31,${opacity*.52})`);
      halo.addColorStop(1,"rgba(85,52,44,0)");
      signCtx.fillStyle=halo;signCtx.fillRect(x-r,y-r,2*r,2*r);
      continue;
    }
    if(label.smoke){
      const r=clamp((.23+label.age*.75)*lens[1]*signs.height/z*.5,1,54);
      if(x+r<0||x-r>signs.width||y+r<0||y-r>signs.height)continue;
      signCtx.save();signCtx.translate(x,y);signCtx.scale(1.4,.79);
      const puff=signCtx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,r);
      const alpha=label.opacity*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-label.age/2.45),1.55);
      puff.addColorStop(0,`rgba(201,205,217,${alpha})`);
      puff.addColorStop(.52,`rgba(169,176,188,${alpha*.62})`);
      puff.addColorStop(1,"rgba(132,145,162,0)");
      signCtx.fillStyle=puff;signCtx.fillRect(-r,-r,2*r,2*r);signCtx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if(label.light){
      if(x<0||x>signs.width||y<0)continue;
      const radius=clamp(430/z,2.7,42)*signs.height/720;
      const halo=signCtx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,radius);
      halo.addColorStop(0,"#fff1cbdc");halo.addColorStop(.21,"#ffd38a73");halo.addColorStop(1,"#ff9d4400");
      signCtx.fillStyle=halo;signCtx.fillRect(x-radius,y-radius,radius*2,radius*2);
      continue;
    }
    const size=clamp(label.size*24/z,8,32)*signs.height/720;
    signCtx.font="bold "+size+"px system-ui";signCtx.textAlign="center";
    signCtx.lineWidth=3;signCtx.strokeStyle="#28251d";signCtx.strokeText(label.text,x,y);
    signCtx.fillStyle="#fff4df";signCtx.fillText(label.text,x,y);
  }
  if(game.elapsed<blastFlashUntil&&!matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches){
    const alpha=(blastFlashUntil-game.elapsed)/.18*.62;
    signCtx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,217,155,${alpha})`;
    signCtx.fillRect(0,0,signs.width,signs.height);
  }

let sceneryCount=0,cabinCount=0,chunk=-1,renderScale=1;
function drawCabinTrim() {

  const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(clientWidth*dpr)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(clientHeight*dpr));
